title: Kubernetes the Hard Way
author: Kelsey Hightower
description: A hands-on tutorial that bootstraps a Kubernetes cluster from scratch, step by step, without a scripted installer — certificates, etcd, the control plane, worker nodes, networking, and smoke tests — to build a real understanding of how Kubernetes works.
